description: BriqLab Flow Sankey is a professional Sankey diagram visual for Microsoft Power BI. It reveals how values flow from one set of categories to another, making it ideal for funnel analysis, budget allocation, customer journey mapping, and process flow visualisation. Key features: 1.Auto-coloured source and destination nodes with proportional sizing 2.Gradient-filled flow paths showing volume between nodes 3.Animated highlight on hover — dim all flows except the focused one 4.Percentage and value labels on flow paths (configurable minimum threshold) 5.Dynamic Power BI tooltips on each flow and each node 6.Click any node to cross-filter other visuals on the report page 7.Right-click a node for the Power BI context menu 8.Fully responsive — re-renders at any viewport size 9.Formatting pane: node width, gap, opacity, font, and flow label controls How to use: 1.Add a Source category field 2.Add a Destination category field 3.Add a numeric Value measure 4.Adjust node width, gap, and opacity in the Format pane 5.Click any node to filter the report — click the background to clear
